name: Viện Phương Nam WorkBuddy-like course landing page

data.purpose: Codes, dates, labels, and compact values

consultationForm.role: source-shaped static consultation form in a native dialog popup with phone fallback

contactRail.role: real phone, website, and back-to-top actions

rules.name: Original reference grammar
rules.body: Use the WorkBuddy-like composition and rhythm without Tencent branding, copy, assets, or URLs.

rules.name: Source truth
rules.body: Reconcile dates, codes, fees, contacts, payment, faculty facts, and certificate rules to the notices. Do not invent registration URLs, QR codes, standalone R pricing, or outcome claims.

rules.name: Heading accent
rules.body: Use a blue-to-light-blue gradient only on short accent phrases in hero and section h1/h2 headings; keep the surrounding heading text black and card h3 text solid. On the blue consultation surface, use the documented white-to-mint contrast variant for readability.

rules.name: Workbench honesty
rules.body: Mark the HTML/CSS product window as a demo and never present simulated rows or outputs as real research results.

rules.name: Motion with purpose
rules.body: Use restrained reveal, tab transition, hover feedback, and one ambient workbench loop. Honor reduced motion.

rules.name: Accessible structure
rules.body: Maintain one h1, visible focus, skip link, keyboard tabs, native FAQ details, real tel links, and no horizontal overflow.

rules.name: Static PHP-shaped form boundary
rules.body: Use the visible field grouping from the supplied PHP form, but omit CAPTCHA/session/hidden endpoint credentials. Validate locally, preserve values, and show a phone fallback; never claim a static submission reached a backend.

rules.name: Fee display truth
rules.body: Show source-backed base prices and discount percentages/conditions only. Never calculate or display final discounted totals in the interface.

rules.name: Surface hierarchy
rules.body: Use the shared contrast-safe blue gradient (#0052D9 to #0B72B1) for schedule, payment, combination price cards, and advantage surfaces; use a light blue wash for the four advantage cards. Reserve translucent white surfaces for the consultation preview and keep other content surfaces opaque.

rules.name: Accent scope
rules.body: Keep the pale blue heading gradient limited to short heading accent phrases. Do not reuse its light endpoint for white card text; use the documented surface gradient so schedule, pricing, payment, and advantage content remains readable.

rules.name: Advantage hierarchy
rules.body: The foundational R/RStudio practice card leads the sequence with a stronger border, surface, and shadow; the remaining three cards remain compact follow-on choices.

rules.name: Contrast and fallback
rules.body: Use contrast-safe endpoints for headings and white text on blue surfaces, keep focus rings visible on both light and blue backgrounds, and preserve a visible phone fallback when JavaScript or native dialog APIs are unavailable.

rules.name: User-supplied trust line
rules.body: Keep the promotion registration statement exactly as supplied by the user, but do not cite it as content extracted from the four course notices.
